info.name: EVE Swagger Interface Alliance Calendar API
EVE Online List Calendar Event Summaries

params.name: character_id
params.description: An EVE character ID

params.name: datasource
params.description: The server name you would like data from

params.name: from_event
params.description: The event ID to retrieve events from

params.name: token
params.description: Access token to use if unable to set a header

items.docs:
Get 50 event summaries from the calendar. If no from_event ID is given, the resource will return the next 50 chronological event summaries from now. If a from_event ID is specified, it will return the next 50 chronological event summaries from after that event

---
